tarpaulin.line: Erm, no, a <mark>tarpaulin</mark> over the clothesline at White Horse Court, Fountain Lakes.
tarpaulin.explain: Wiktionary puts it as: Canvas waterproofed with tar, used as a cover. Close cousins: tarp. A kind of canvas. Usually marked archaic.
tarpaulin.ety: From tar + pall (“heavy canvas”) + -ing. The sailor sense reflects that sailors of centuries past often wore garments made of tarred cloth (for weatherproofing)
